title: Part Status is disabled for a user without Delete
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • A second user, {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL User B), has the custom role {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL STATDIS ROLE), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit' on and Delete off, and access to {Location-A}.
  • {User-B} is signed in at {Location-A} in a second browser (or a private window).
  • Active part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-STATDIS-01) is stocked at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. As {User-B}, type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Click the Inactive option.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. As the Admin, type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  6. Click the {Part-A} row.
  7. Click the Inactive option.
  8. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Part Status shows Active selected, but the choice is disabled (greyed out).
  • Step 3: nothing changes: Active stays selected.
  • Step 7: for the Admin the choice is enabled and Inactive becomes selected.
  • Step 8: the window closes without saving, and {Part-A} stays on the Active tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R20, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.1 (Part Status in the dialog), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R20: “When editing, a "Part Status" choice offers two options, Active and Inactive, set to the part's saved status. A user without the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission sees the choice disabled.”
